dedupe_keys.name: bundesnetzagentur breitbandmessung and netzcheck funkloch app measured broadband speeds and mobile dead zones germany

description: Breitbandmessung is the Bundesnetzagentur's official service for users to measure the data rates of their internet connections and compare them with the speeds in their contracts, using a desktop application, a browser test or a mobile app. A separate app, the Mobilfunk-Check or Netzcheck (formerly the Funkloch app), records whether a mobile signal is present at 2G, 4G or 5G level and so maps dead zones reported by users. The agency publishes annual reports and interactive graphics on fixed and mobile results, maps of measurements for fixed and mobile networks, results of mobile measurement weeks, and tables and graphics from the Netzcheck app that evaluate the last twelve months of the dead-zone map on filled 100-metre grid cells, broken down by federal state and district with numbers of measurement points per state. Coverage: Germany. Format and access: web maps, interactive graphics and PDF reports, free; no bulk download of individual measurements was found. Caveats: crowdsourced measurements depend on who tests and where; results are aggregated, and licence terms for reuse were not stated on the pages read. Simulation uses: evidence of real service quality and dead zones for validating coverage models, and baselines for spotting degradation during outages or disasters. Related records: the Mobilfunk-Monitoring gives operator-reported coverage, the Breitbandatlas gives fixed availability, and RTR-NetTest and ČTÚ-NetTest are neighbouring crowdsourced tools.
